core_contract: Machine validation -> independent human review -> APPROVED -> explicit publish batch -> PUBLISHED
approval_gate: reviewer_id must differ from author/generator actor; Iman ownership does not waive independent review for real Production questions
published_edit: immutable in place; changes create new revision and repeat validation/review
fast_disable: critical user report may disable serving through overlay without deleting history
queue_order: P0 critical report -> P1 re-review -> P2 ready for review; then age, Stage9 gap, Stage3 TCF as tie-breakers
